high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the Times of India website, specifically from the "Gadgets Now" section. The headline reads: "How Google Lost More Than $150 Billion After This ‘One Sentence’ From OpenAI CEO Sam Altman." The article is dated October 23, 2025, at 9:04 AM. The main content of the article discusses how the launch of OpenAI's new AI browser, ChatGPT Atlas, has significantly impacted Alphabet (Google's parent company). The article mentions that the launch caused a massive $150 billion drop in Alphabet
